# Repository collaboration metadata

Contribution templates support [brewpi-remix/brewpi-emulator-rmx](https://github.com/brewpi-remix/brewpi-emulator-rmx), the public GitHub repository. Milestones 1–5 and cross-milestone fixes are published. No CI workflow, automated test job, repository-rule change, or release/publishing workflow has been created by the current policy work.

The [R1 support/release policy](../engineering/development/software-release-policy.md) defines future check names, single-maintainer review, trust boundaries, and first candidate version 0.0.1-rc.1. R2 must implement real checks against the existing build/test facilities only after it is authorized. Policy documentation is not an active workflow or passing CI evidence, and no placeholder job or automated publication belongs in this task.
